subject.title: feat(scripts): serialize pr prepare gates and add remote Testbox test gate

question: Should `scripts/pr` support `OPENCLAW_PR_GATES_REMOTE=testbox` as a second remote prepare-gate mode alongside `OPENCLAW_TESTBOX=1`, after the stale-stamp bug is fixed?
rationale: The diff changes maintainer landing gate evidence and adds a new env-controlled remote execution path; code review can identify the stale-stamp defect, but the permanent gate policy needs owner intent.

options.title: Fix and land the opt-in mode
options.body: Keep the new remote full-test gate, clear stale `REMOTE_GATES_*` values on hosted mode, and document that maintainers intentionally choose this path when exact-head hosted gates are not enough.

options.title: Use only the hosted verifier
options.body: Drop the new remote full-test mode and keep the whole-block local lock while routing remote proof through the existing `OPENCLAW_TESTBOX=1` exact-head verifier.

options.title: Pause for gate policy
options.body: Leave the linked issue open until release-gate owners decide how `scripts/pr` should balance local locking, hosted CI evidence, and Crabbox/Testbox runs.

recommendation.title: Fix and land the opt-in mode
recommendation.body: Keep the new remote full-test gate, clear stale `REMOTE_GATES_*` values on hosted mode, and document that maintainers intentionally choose this path when exact-head hosted gates are not enough.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent work touches changed-check and release gate behavior, making this the best available owner for the remote-gate policy choice.
